authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI artifacts that severely impact authenticity. Most notably, the pigs riding the motorcycles show severe fusion/melting where their lower bodies merge into the bike seats and frames without distinct legs or proper riding posture (severity 4). The front wheels and suspension of the motorcycles lack mechanical logic, appearing to float or connect incorrectly (severity 3). The scale of the violin is disproportionately large compared to the motorcycles, violating real-world perspective (severity 2). While the foreground pigs are rendered with better anatomical integrity, the background elements suffer from structural collapse and texture anomalies (plastic-like skin, severity 2). These compound issues justify a low authenticity score.
